system.description: When you take a Full Attack Action, you can treat a ranged weapon with a Bayonet (or Vibrobayonet) as a Double Weapon. You can attack with the Bayonet (or Vibrobayonet) and club a target with your ranged Weapon (as with the Gun Club Talent), ignoring the normal penalties for attacking with both ends of a Double Weapon.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Clone Wars Campaign Guide
